{{Top}}
[[File:B2ZeroG-SaV.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] unable to gain footing with the artificial gravity generators offline.]]
'''Artificial gravity generators''', '''gravidic generators'''<ref name="TFAD">{{JournalCite|6|To Fight Another Day}}</ref> or '''gravity field generators'''<ref name="RE">{{DarkStryder|adventure=Rogue Elements|book=The Kathol Rift}}</ref> were used to create a stable field of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] outside of a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] natural gravity well, thus aiding life in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. They were also used to compress objects&mdash;for storage purposes with gaseous commodities, and sometimes to create synthetic gems.

[[Silver Station]] used an array of generators taken from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to produce artificial gravity, including 90-degree gravity shifts in certain sections of the station.<ref name="TFAD" />
